description: FR-C7-11. Replacing a verified document updates the in-memory cache. POST /license/reload on the management app requires the admin key. The gateway app does not expose that route.
scope: A new signed document changes the cache from expired to active
POST /license/reload with the admin key returns reloaded
The gateway returns 404 for that path
acceptanceCriteria: reload_document of an active signed license replaces an expired cache with active. POST /license/reload with header X-Api-Key admin-key returns 200 and status reloaded. A missing key is 401. The gateway POST /license/reload returns 404 and the body does not contain reloaded. FR-C7-11.
constraints: Do not mount /license/reload on the gateway app.
Do not accept a bad signature during reload.
Do not require a process restart.
